title: Ordinary cochain evaluation of the pullback tensor unit comparison
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbb Q_\ell$, a morphism $f:X\to Y$, and a quotient level $n$. Let $F$ be the ordinary sequence inverse image and let $V,W$ be sequence evaluation at $n$ on $Y,X$, respectively, as in [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations]. Let $G$ be the intrinsic finite inverse image of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $c$ identify the ordinary finite inverse image with $G$ and send their actual adjunction-unit sections to each other. Write $d_A:WFA\simeq GVA$ for the inverse of the prescribed ordinary evaluation mate followed by $c$, termwise on complexes. For arbitrary unbounded sequence complexes $P,Q$, let $k:G(VP\otimes VQ)\simeq GVP\otimes GVQ$ be any ordinary total-cochain isomorphism satisfying FinitePullbackTensorGenerators of [lem-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-kflat-normalization]. If $b:F(P\otimes Q)\simeq FP\otimes FQ$ is the unit-normalized sequence total comparison and $v,w$ are the generator-normalized ordinary evaluation comparisons of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], then $W(b)\,w\,(d_P\otimes d_Q)=d_{P\otimes Q}\,G(v)\,k$. Tensor means the displayed ordinary total cochain tensor, with all degrees and differentials. There is no K-flatness, derived comparison, or derived tensor-model hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product, final ordinary total-complex comparison; Tags 0941 and 03D2 for sequence evaluation and the ordinary adjunction units.

proof.text: Apply the proved ordinary evaluation-unit criterion to the map given by evaluated sequence tensor comparison, X evaluation tensor comparison and the tensor of the two ordinary evaluation mates. The criterion keeps the target complex abstract during its inverse-unit transposition.

On each total pure generator, the proved evaluation generator formula identifies the first map with the tensor of the two intrinsic unit sections. The finite comparison generator normalization hk identifies k applied to the intrinsic unit of the evaluated total generator with that same tensor. Transitivity supplies the criterion hypothesis and proves the cochain square.

theorem completedPullbackTensor_evaluation_cochain {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (c : integralOperationsLevelPullback l E f n ≅
      sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f)
    (hc : ∀ (A : normalizedDVRModules l E Y n) (U : Y.ProEt)
      (x : A.val.obj (op U)),
      (c.hom.app A).val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
        (((coefficientProEtaleModuleAdjunction.{u, u} f
          (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1}
            (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))))).unit.app A).val.app (op U) x) =
      ((sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f
        (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))).unit.app A).val.app (op U) x)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ)
    (k : ((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj
      ((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology Y)
        (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n)).obj
        ((((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P),
         (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))) ≅
      (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology X)
        (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)).obj
        ((((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)),
         (((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))))
    (hk : FinitePullbackTensorGenerators l E f n
      (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
      (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) k) :
    let F : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ ⥤
        CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E X) ℤ :=
      (pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let V : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ ⥤
        CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y n) ℤ :=
      (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let W : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E X) ℤ ⥤
        CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E X n) ℤ :=
      (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let G : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y n) ℤ ⥤
        CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E X n) ℤ :=
      (sfIntrinsicPullback
        (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let d (A : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ) :
        W.obj (F.obj A) ⟶ G.obj (V.obj A) :=
      (pullbackTensorInverseEvaluationComplex l E f n).inv.app A ≫
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex c (.up ℤ)).hom.app (V.obj A)
    W.map ((pullbackTensorSequenceCochain l E f).hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
      (coefficientEvaluationTensorIso l E X n (F.obj P) (F.obj Q)).hom ≫
      (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology X)
        (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)).map
        (Prod.mkHom (d P) (d Q)) =
    (d ((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u}
      (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology Y))
      (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E Y)).obj (P, Q))) ≫
      G.map (coefficientEvaluationTensorIso l E Y n P Q).hom ≫ k.hom
